Network Devices.reason_zh: Remote Desktop Client 未初始化资源使用漏洞可导致网络远程代码执行，可在早期连接初始化阶段被利用。

Network Devices.reason: HTTP.sys heap overflow enables local privilege escalation, impacting the core Windows HTTP request processing stack.
Network Devices.reason_en: HTTP.sys heap overflow enables local privilege escalation, impacting the core Windows HTTP request processing stack.
Network Devices.reason_zh: HTTP.sys 堆溢出漏洞可实现本地权限提升，影响核心 Windows HTTP 请求处理栈。

Network Devices.reason: DHCP Server privilege escalation allows adjacent network privesc, weakening the DHCP service security model.
Network Devices.reason_en: DHCP Server privilege escalation allows adjacent network privesc, weakening the DHCP service security model.
Network Devices.reason_zh: DHCP Server 权限提升漏洞允许相邻网络提权，削弱了 DHCP 服务的安全模型。

Network Devices.reason: Remote Access Connection Manager heap overflow enables local privilege escalation, targeting VPN and RAS connectivity services.
Network Devices.reason_en: Remote Access Connection Manager heap overflow enables local privilege escalation, targeting VPN and RAS connectivity services.
Network Devices.reason_zh: Remote Access Connection Manager 堆溢出漏洞可实现本地权限提升，针对 VPN 和 RAS 连接服务。

Network Devices.reason: RPC Runtime heap overflow allows network RCE, compromising the inter-process communication backbone used by numerous Windows services.
Network Devices.reason_en: RPC Runtime heap overflow allows network RCE, compromising the inter-process communication backbone used by numerous Windows services.
Network Devices.reason_zh: RPC Runtime 堆溢出漏洞可导致网络远程代码执行，破坏众多 Windows 服务所使用的进程间通信基础架构。

Network Devices.reason: Heap overflow in Windows DHCP Server allows remote code execution over adjacent networks, disrupting critical IP address management and network provisioning.
Network Devices.reason_en: Heap overflow in Windows DHCP Server allows remote code execution over adjacent networks, disrupting critical IP address management and network provisioning.
Network Devices.reason_zh: Windows DHCP Server 中的堆溢出漏洞允许通过相邻网络进行远程代码执行，破坏关键的 IP 地址管理与网络配置功能。

Network Devices.reason: Race condition in DNS Server enables remote code execution, threatening network stability and reliable name resolution across enterprise environments.
Network Devices.reason_en: Race condition in DNS Server enables remote code execution, threatening network stability and reliable name resolution across enterprise environments.
Network Devices.reason_zh: DNS Server 中的竞态条件漏洞可实现远程代码执行，威胁企业环境中的网络稳定性与可靠的名称解析。

Network Devices.reason: Stack buffer overflow in Active Directory Federation Services allows remote denial-of-service, impacting enterprise SSO and authentication availability.
Network Devices.reason_en: Stack buffer overflow in Active Directory Federation Services allows remote denial-of-service, impacting enterprise SSO and authentication availability.
Network Devices.reason_zh: Active Directory Federation Services 中的栈缓冲区溢出漏洞可导致远程拒绝服务，影响企业 SSO 与身份验证服务的可用性。

Network Devices.reason: CVSS 9.8 stack overflow in DNS permits remote code execution, critically undermining name resolution services essential for network connectivity.
Network Devices.reason_en: CVSS 9.8 stack overflow in DNS permits remote code execution, critically undermining name resolution services essential for network connectivity.
Network Devices.reason_zh: DNS 中 CVSS 评分为 9.8 的栈溢出漏洞允许远程代码执行，严重破坏了网络连接所必需的名称解析服务。

Network Devices.reason: Remote code execution via QUIC use-after-free affects modern encrypted transport protocols, impacting widespread client-server communications.
Network Devices.reason_en: Remote code execution via QUIC use-after-free affects modern encrypted transport protocols, impacting widespread client-server communications.
Network Devices.reason_zh: 通过 QUIC 释放后使用漏洞实现的远程代码执行影响现代加密传输协议，波及广泛的客户端-服务器通信。

Network Devices.reason: Direct remote code execution in RRAS compromises routing and remote access services, granting attackers unauthorized network entry points.
Network Devices.reason_en: Direct remote code execution in RRAS compromises routing and remote access services, granting attackers unauthorized network entry points.
Network Devices.reason_zh: RRAS 中的直接远程代码执行漏洞会破坏路由与远程访问服务，为攻击者提供未经授权的网络入口点。

Network Devices.reason: TCP/IP stack buffer overflow enables remote code execution, exploiting fundamental networking protocols to destabilize host communication.
Network Devices.reason_en: TCP/IP stack buffer overflow enables remote code execution, exploiting fundamental networking protocols to destabilize host communication.
Network Devices.reason_zh: TCP/IP 协议栈缓冲区溢出漏洞可实现远程代码执行，利用基础网络协议破坏主机通信的稳定性。

Network Devices.reason: Race condition in DNS allows remote code execution, exploiting synchronization flaws in critical resolver components for network disruption.
Network Devices.reason_en: Race condition in DNS allows remote code execution, exploiting synchronization flaws in critical resolver components for network disruption.
Network Devices.reason_zh: DNS 中的竞态条件漏洞允许远程代码执行，利用关键解析器组件的同步缺陷造成网络中断。

Network Devices.reason: HTTP.sys heap overflow impacts the core Windows HTTP protocol stack, threatening IIS deployments and web traffic handling capabilities.
Network Devices.reason_en: HTTP.sys heap overflow impacts the core Windows HTTP protocol stack, threatening IIS deployments and web traffic handling capabilities.
Network Devices.reason_zh: HTTP.sys 堆溢出漏洞影响核心 Windows HTTP 协议栈，威胁 IIS 部署及 Web 流量处理能力。

Network Devices.reason: Heap-based buffer overflow in the DHCP Server service enables network-based code execution, disrupting critical network address management.
Network Devices.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in the DHCP Server service enables network-based code execution, disrupting critical network address management.
Network Devices.reason_zh: DHCP Server 服务中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞可实现基于网络的代码执行，破坏关键的网络地址管理功能。

Network Devices.reason: Command injection in Windows Active Directory allows network-based code execution targeting directory services and authentication infrastructure.
Network Devices.reason_en: Command injection in Windows Active Directory allows network-based code execution targeting directory services and authentication infrastructure.
Network Devices.reason_zh: Windows Active Directory 中的命令注入漏洞允许基于网络的代码执行，针对目录服务与身份验证基础设施。

Network Devices.reason: Heap-based buffer overflow in the Remote Desktop Client exploits remote access connections to execute arbitrary code on target endpoints.
Network Devices.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in the Remote Desktop Client exploits remote access connections to execute arbitrary code on target endpoints.
Network Devices.reason_zh: Remote Desktop Client 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞利用远程访问连接在目标终端上执行任意代码。

Network Devices.reason: Command injection in the Azure Monitor Agent risks monitoring infrastructure compromise by granting elevated network privileges to attackers.
Network Devices.reason_en: Command injection in the Azure Monitor Agent risks monitoring infrastructure compromise by granting elevated network privileges to attackers.
Network Devices.reason_zh: Azure Monitor Agent 中的命令注入漏洞可能因向攻击者授予提升的网络权限而导致监控基础设施被攻破。

Network Devices.reason: Heap-based buffer overflow in the Windows FTP Service enables remote code execution, impacting legacy file transfer operations and network accessibility.
Network Devices.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in the Windows FTP Service enables remote code execution, impacting legacy file transfer operations and network accessibility.
Network Devices.reason_zh: Windows FTP Service 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞可实现远程代码执行，影响传统文件传输操作与网络可访问性。

Network Devices.reason: Race condition in the Windows TCP/IP stack allows remote code execution over adjacent networks, affecting fundamental network connectivity and routing.
Network Devices.reason_en: Race condition in the Windows TCP/IP stack allows remote code execution over adjacent networks, affecting fundamental network connectivity and routing.
Network Devices.reason_zh: Windows TCP/IP 协议栈中的竞态条件漏洞允许通过相邻网络进行远程代码执行，影响基础网络连接与路由。

Network Devices.reason: Insufficient access control granularity in Active Directory Federation Services (CISA KEV) enables local privilege escalation and is actively exploited in the wild.
Network Devices.reason_en: Insufficient access control granularity in Active Directory Federation Services (CISA KEV) enables local privilege escalation and is actively exploited in the wild.
Network Devices.reason_zh: Active Directory Federation Services（CISA KEV）的访问控制粒度不足漏洞可实现本地权限提升，且已在实际环境中被积极利用。

Network Devices.reason: Vulnerability in Windows DHCP Server allows unauthorized network tampering, potentially disrupting IP address allocation and causing widespread connectivity failures.
Network Devices.reason_en: Vulnerability in Windows DHCP Server allows unauthorized network tampering, potentially disrupting IP address allocation and causing widespread connectivity failures.
Network Devices.reason_zh: Windows DHCP Server 中的漏洞允许未经授权的篡改，可能破坏 IP 地址分配并导致广泛的连接故障。

Network Devices.reason: Type confusion in Universal Plug and Play (UPnP) enables remote code execution, exposing home and enterprise networks to lateral movement and device takeover.
Network Devices.reason_en: Type confusion in Universal Plug and Play (UPnP) enables remote code execution, exposing home and enterprise networks to lateral movement and device takeover.
Network Devices.reason_zh: Universal Plug and Play (UPnP) 中的类型混淆漏洞可实现远程代码执行，使家庭和企业网络面临横向移动与设备接管风险。

Network Devices.reason: Malformed WebSocket frames in Eclipse Mosquitto cause memory corruption and denial-of-service, disrupting critical MQTT messaging infrastructure.
Network Devices.reason_en: Malformed WebSocket frames in Eclipse Mosquitto cause memory corruption and denial-of-service, disrupting critical MQTT messaging infrastructure.
Network Devices.reason_zh: Eclipse Mosquitto 中格式错误的 WebSocket 帧会导致内存损坏与拒绝服务，破坏关键的 MQTT 消息传递基础设施。

Network Devices.reason: FabioLB processes raw URL paths without proper sanitization, bypassing ACL and authentication checks to forward traffic to unauthorized backends.
Network Devices.reason_en: FabioLB processes raw URL paths without proper sanitization, bypassing ACL and authentication checks to forward traffic to unauthorized backends.
Network Devices.reason_zh: FabioLB 在未进行适当过滤的情况下处理原始 URL 路径，绕过 ACL 与身份验证检查，将流量转发至未授权的后端服务。

Network Devices.reason: Poweradmin lacks rate limiting on MFA verification endpoints, exposing DNS administration interfaces to automated brute-force attacks.
Network Devices.reason_en: Poweradmin lacks rate limiting on MFA verification endpoints, exposing DNS administration interfaces to automated brute-force attacks.
Network Devices.reason_zh: Poweradmin 未在 MFA 验证端点上实施速率限制，导致 DNS 管理接口暴露于自动化暴力破解攻击之下。

Network Devices.reason: SQL injection in WatchGuard Dimension's log collection service grants authenticated attackers arbitrary code execution on firewall management appliances.
Network Devices.reason_en: SQL injection in WatchGuard Dimension's log collection service grants authenticated attackers arbitrary code execution on firewall management appliances.
Network Devices.reason_zh: WatchGuard Dimension 日志收集服务中的 SQL 注入漏洞可使已认证的攻击者在防火墙管理设备上执行任意代码。

Network Devices.reason: CRLF injection in the network appliance's email configuration handler leads to operating system command execution with local mail account privileges.
Network Devices.reason_en: CRLF injection in the network appliance's email configuration handler leads to operating system command execution with local mail account privileges.
Network Devices.reason_zh: 网络设备电子邮件配置处理器中的 CRLF 注入漏洞可导致以本地邮件账户权限执行操作系统命令。

Network Devices.reason: Path traversal in Synway SMG Gateway management software allows unauthenticated attackers to exfiltrate sensitive system configuration files.
Network Devices.reason_en: Path traversal in Synway SMG Gateway management software allows unauthenticated attackers to exfiltrate sensitive system configuration files.
Network Devices.reason_zh: Synway SMG Gateway 管理软件中的路径遍历漏洞允许未认证的攻击者窃取敏感的系统配置文件。

Network Devices.reason: Blind command injection in Mitel MiCollab conferencing components enables remote code execution on VoIP and unified communications infrastructure.
Network Devices.reason_en: Blind command injection in Mitel MiCollab conferencing components enables remote code execution on VoIP and unified communications infrastructure.
Network Devices.reason_zh: Mitel MiCollab 会议组件中的盲命令注入漏洞可在 VoIP 和统一通信基础设施上实现远程代码执行。

Network Devices.reason: Buffer overflow in Dell PowerStore SDNAS firmware permits denial of service or potential remote code execution on network-attached storage nodes.
Network Devices.reason_en: Buffer overflow in Dell PowerStore SDNAS firmware permits denial of service or potential remote code execution on network-attached storage nodes.
Network Devices.reason_zh: Dell PowerStore SDNAS 固件中的缓冲区溢出漏洞可导致网络附加存储节点发生拒绝服务或潜在的远程代码执行。

Network Devices.reason: Unauthenticated XML injection in conferencing software allows pre-staged content exploitation leading to remote code execution.
Network Devices.reason_en: Unauthenticated XML injection in conferencing software allows pre-staged content exploitation leading to remote code execution.
Network Devices.reason_zh: 会议软件中无需认证的 XML 注入漏洞允许攻击者利用预置内容，进而导致远程代码执行。

Network Devices.reason: Remote stack-based buffer overflow in backup functionality allows attackers to execute arbitrary code on managed routers.
Network Devices.reason_en: Remote stack-based buffer overflow in backup functionality allows attackers to execute arbitrary code on managed routers.
Network Devices.reason_zh: 备份功能中的远程基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许攻击者在受管路由器上执行任意代码。

Network Devices.reason: ACL misconfiguration grants read-only users root-level file execution capabilities, enabling full router compromise via ubus commands.
Network Devices.reason_en: ACL misconfiguration grants read-only users root-level file execution capabilities, enabling full router compromise via ubus commands.
Network Devices.reason_zh: ACL 错误配置使只读用户获得根级文件执行权限，可通过 ubus 命令完全接管路由器。

Network Devices.reason: HTTP/2 flow control logic error triggers heap corruption in NGINX workers, potentially leading to remote code execution in high-traffic reverse proxy deployments.
Network Devices.reason_en: HTTP/2 flow control logic error triggers heap corruption in NGINX workers, potentially leading to remote code execution in high-traffic reverse proxy deployments.
Network Devices.reason_zh: HTTP/2 流量控制逻辑错误会触发 NGINX worker 进程的堆损坏，可能在高流量反向代理部署环境中导致远程代码执行。

Network Devices.reason: Crafted HTTP/2 requests under resource constraints cause use-after-free conditions in worker processes, risking crashes or arbitrary code execution.
Network Devices.reason_en: Crafted HTTP/2 requests under resource constraints cause use-after-free conditions in worker processes, risking crashes or arbitrary code execution.
Network Devices.reason_zh: 资源受限条件下构造的 HTTP/2 请求会导致 worker 进程出现释放后使用（UAF）漏洞，可能引发崩溃或任意代码执行。

Network Devices.reason: Bypasses private CA pinning by accepting publicly trusted root certificates, allowing on-path attackers to intercept encrypted traffic.
Network Devices.reason_en: Bypasses private CA pinning by accepting publicly trusted root certificates, allowing on-path attackers to intercept encrypted traffic.
Network Devices.reason_zh: 通过接受公共信任的根证书绕过私有 CA 固定机制，允许中间人攻击者拦截加密流量。

Network Devices.reason: Wildcard certificate validation flaw permits partial-label matching, facilitating DNS rebinding and MITM attacks against TLS connections.
Network Devices.reason_en: Wildcard certificate validation flaw permits partial-label matching, facilitating DNS rebinding and MITM attacks against TLS connections.
Network Devices.reason_zh: 通配符证书验证缺陷允许部分标签匹配，从而助长针对 TLS 连接的 DNS 重绑定和中间人攻击。

Network Devices.reason: CVSS 9.6 Dell PowerStore storage processor flaw allows unauthenticated peers to trigger out-of-bounds writes, leading to system-level code execution.
Network Devices.reason_en: CVSS 9.6 Dell PowerStore storage processor flaw allows unauthenticated peers to trigger out-of-bounds writes, leading to system-level code execution.
Network Devices.reason_zh: CVSS 9.6 的 Dell PowerStore 存储处理器漏洞允许未认证的对等节点触发越界写入，从而导致系统级代码执行。

Network Devices.reason: CVSS 10.0 HPE AOS-10 PAPI protocol vulnerability enables unauthenticated remote attackers to bypass authentication controls and gain full administrative access.
Network Devices.reason_en: CVSS 10.0 HPE AOS-10 PAPI protocol vulnerability enables unauthenticated remote attackers to bypass authentication controls and gain full administrative access.
Network Devices.reason_zh: CVSS 10.0 的 HPE AOS-10 PAPI 协议漏洞使未认证的远程攻击者能够绕过身份验证控制并获取完全的管理员权限。

Network Devices.reason: CVSS 9.3 F5 BIG-IP iRule processing flaw can crash the Traffic Management Microkernel and may lead to remote code execution on affected virtual servers.
Network Devices.reason_en: CVSS 9.3 F5 BIG-IP iRule processing flaw can crash the Traffic Management Microkernel and may lead to remote code execution on affected virtual servers.
Network Devices.reason_zh: CVSS 9.3 的 F5 BIG-IP iRule 处理漏洞可能导致流量管理微内核崩溃，并可能在受影响的虚拟服务器上引发远程代码执行。

Industrial Control.reason: Integer overflow in Azure Data Manager for Energy allows network-based code execution, threatening OT data pipelines and industrial monitoring systems.
Industrial Control.reason_en: Integer overflow in Azure Data Manager for Energy allows network-based code execution, threatening OT data pipelines and industrial monitoring systems.
Industrial Control.reason_zh: Azure Data Manager for Energy 中的整数溢出漏洞允许基于网络的代码执行，威胁运营技术数据管道和工业监控系统。

Industrial Control.reason: A race condition in OpenPLC Runtime allows unauthenticated attackers to bypass existence checks and create rogue administrator accounts on PLC systems.
Industrial Control.reason_en: A race condition in OpenPLC Runtime allows unauthenticated attackers to bypass existence checks and create rogue administrator accounts on PLC systems.
Industrial Control.reason_zh: OpenPLC Runtime 中的竞态条件漏洞允许未认证的攻击者绕过存在性检查，并在 PLC 系统中创建恶意管理员账户。

Web Security.reason: Blind SQL Injection in PublishPress Authors plugin allows attackers to extract database contents or modify site configurations remotely, exploiting widespread WordPress deployments.
Web Security.reason_en: Blind SQL Injection in PublishPress Authors plugin allows attackers to extract database contents or modify site configurations remotely, exploiting widespread WordPress deployments.
Web Security.reason_zh: PublishPress Authors 插件中的盲 SQL 注入漏洞允许攻击者远程提取数据库内容或修改站点配置，可被广泛利用于 WordPress 部署环境。

Web Security.reason: Incorrect default permissions in ASP.NET Core enable local privilege escalation, weakening the security boundary for modern web application deployments and containerized services.
Web Security.reason_en: Incorrect default permissions in ASP.NET Core enable local privilege escalation, weakening the security boundary for modern web application deployments and containerized services.
Web Security.reason_zh: ASP.NET Core 中不正确的默认权限可导致本地提权，削弱现代 Web 应用部署和容器化服务的安全边界。

Web Security.reason: Path traversal in Dynamics Business Central allows authenticated attackers to read restricted files, exposing sensitive business logic and customer data.
Web Security.reason_en: Path traversal in Dynamics Business Central allows authenticated attackers to read restricted files, exposing sensitive business logic and customer data.
Web Security.reason_zh: Dynamics Business Central 中的路径遍历漏洞允许已认证的攻击者读取受限文件，从而暴露敏感的业务逻辑和客户数据。

Web Security.reason: Permits remote code execution over the network by exploiting flawed code generation controls in ASP.NET Core web applications.
Web Security.reason_en: Permits remote code execution over the network by exploiting flawed code generation controls in ASP.NET Core web applications.
Web Security.reason_zh: 通过利用 ASP.NET Core Web 应用中存在缺陷的代码生成控制机制，允许通过网络实现远程代码执行。

Web Security.reason: Enables remote code execution through unsafe handling of serialized objects, a persistent threat to web application backends.
Web Security.reason_en: Enables remote code execution through unsafe handling of serialized objects, a persistent threat to web application backends.
Web Security.reason_zh: 通过对序列化对象的不安全处理实现远程代码执行，这对 Web 应用后端构成持续威胁。

Web Security.reason: Cross-site scripting in ASP.NET Core allows remote code execution. Developers relying on this framework must patch immediately to prevent browser-based attacks and session hijacking.
Web Security.reason_en: Cross-site scripting in ASP.NET Core allows remote code execution. Developers relying on this framework must patch immediately to prevent browser-based attacks and session hijacking.
Web Security.reason_zh: ASP.NET Core 中的跨站脚本（XSS）漏洞可导致远程代码执行。依赖此框架的开发者必须立即打补丁，以防止基于浏览器的攻击和会话劫持。

Web Security.reason: Improper authentication in ASP.NET Core enables network privilege escalation. Weak authentication checks can allow unauthorized users to access restricted web application features.
Web Security.reason_en: Improper authentication in ASP.NET Core enables network privilege escalation. Weak authentication checks can allow unauthorized users to access restricted web application features.
Web Security.reason_zh: ASP.NET Core 中的身份验证不当可导致网络提权。薄弱的身份验证检查可能允许未授权用户访问受限的 Web 应用功能。

Web Security.reason: Cross-site scripting in Microsoft Teams allows network spoofing. Attackers could inject malicious scripts to trick users into revealing credentials or performing unintended actions.
Web Security.reason_en: Cross-site scripting in Microsoft Teams allows network spoofing. Attackers could inject malicious scripts to trick users into revealing credentials or performing unintended actions.
Web Security.reason_zh: Microsoft Teams 中的跨站脚本（XSS）漏洞可导致网络欺骗。攻击者可注入恶意脚本诱骗用户泄露凭据或执行非预期操作。

Web Security.reason: HTTP request/response smuggling in ASP.NET Core allows network-based request tampering, potentially bypassing security controls and enabling cache poisoning attacks.
Web Security.reason_en: HTTP request/response smuggling in ASP.NET Core allows network-based request tampering, potentially bypassing security controls and enabling cache poisoning attacks.
Web Security.reason_zh: ASP.NET Core 中的 HTTP 请求/响应走私漏洞允许基于网络的请求篡改，可能绕过安全控制并实施缓存投毒攻击。

Web Security.reason: Integer overflow in SharePoint leads to remote code execution over a network, exposing widely deployed enterprise collaboration platforms to severe compromise.
Web Security.reason_en: Integer overflow in SharePoint leads to remote code execution over a network, exposing widely deployed enterprise collaboration platforms to severe compromise.
Web Security.reason_zh: SharePoint 中的整数溢出漏洞可导致基于网络的远程代码执行，使广泛部署的企业协作平台面临严重的安全风险。

Web Security.reason: Heap-based buffer overflow in the XPS Document Converter enables remote code execution over a network through malicious document rendering.
Web Security.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in the XPS Document Converter enables remote code execution over a network through malicious document rendering.
Web Security.reason_zh: XPS Document Converter 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞可通过恶意文档渲染实现基于网络的远程代码执行。

Web Security.reason: Extremely high severity cross-site scripting and spoofing vulnerability in Exchange Server targets its web interface, enabling widespread client-side attacks.
Web Security.reason_en: Extremely high severity cross-site scripting and spoofing vulnerability in Exchange Server targets its web interface, enabling widespread client-side attacks.
Web Security.reason_zh: Exchange Server 中存在极高严重性的跨站脚本与欺骗漏洞，针对其 Web 界面，可引发广泛的客户端攻击。

Web Security.reason: Stack-based buffer overflow in Skype for Business and Lync allows network-based code execution, exploiting the web conferencing platform's attack surface.
Web Security.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in Skype for Business and Lync allows network-based code execution, exploiting the web conferencing platform's attack surface.
Web Security.reason_zh: Skype for Business 和 Lync 中的基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许基于网络的代码执行，利用了该 Web 会议平台的攻击面。

Web Security.reason: Stack-based buffer overflow in Exchange Server enables unauthorized network code execution, directly targeting internet-facing web services.
Web Security.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in Exchange Server enables unauthorized network code execution, directly targeting internet-facing web services.
Web Security.reason_zh: Exchange Server 中的基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞可实现未经授权的基于网络的代码执行，直接针对面向互联网的 Web 服务。

Web Security.reason: Deserialization of untrusted data in SharePoint enables unauthenticated network RCE. This flaw directly targets web-facing collaboration platforms, allowing attackers to execute arbitrary code remotely.
Web Security.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in SharePoint enables unauthenticated network RCE. This flaw directly targets web-facing collaboration platforms, allowing attackers to execute arbitrary code remotely.
Web Security.reason_zh: SharePoint 中对不可信数据的反序列化漏洞可导致未认证的基于网络的远程代码执行（RCE）。该缺陷直接针对面向 Web 的协作平台，允许攻击者远程执行任意代码。

Web Security.reason: Incorrect authorization in SharePoint allows network-level privilege escalation. Weak access controls in SharePoint can expose sensitive organizational data and administrative functions to unauthorized users.
Web Security.reason_en: Incorrect authorization in SharePoint allows network-level privilege escalation. Weak access controls in SharePoint can expose sensitive organizational data and administrative functions to unauthorized users.
Web Security.reason_zh: SharePoint中的授权不当允许网络级权限提升。SharePoint中薄弱的访问控制可能使敏感的组织数据和管理功能暴露给未授权用户。

Web Security.reason: Cross-site scripting in Visual Studio Code allows remote code execution, exposing developer toolchains and web-based IDE environments.
Web Security.reason_en: Cross-site scripting in Visual Studio Code allows remote code execution, exposing developer toolchains and web-based IDE environments.
Web Security.reason_zh: Visual Studio Code中的跨站脚本漏洞可导致远程代码执行，暴露开发者工具链和基于Web的IDE环境。

Web Security.reason: Missing resource limits in ASP.NET Core enable remote denial of service, directly impacting web application availability.
Web Security.reason_en: Missing resource limits in ASP.NET Core enable remote denial of service, directly impacting web application availability.
Web Security.reason_zh: ASP.NET Core中缺少资源限制可导致远程拒绝服务，直接影响Web应用程序的可用性。

Web Security.reason: Deserialization of untrusted data in SharePoint allows remote code execution, targeting enterprise content management platforms.
Web Security.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in SharePoint allows remote code execution, targeting enterprise content management platforms.
Web Security.reason_zh: SharePoint中不受信任数据的反序列化可导致远程代码执行，针对企业内容管理平台。

Web Security.reason: Server-side request forgery in SharePoint allows attackers to elevate privileges over the network, enabling internal network pivoting, metadata harvesting, and data exfiltration.
Web Security.reason_en: Server-side request forgery in SharePoint allows attackers to elevate privileges over the network, enabling internal network pivoting, metadata harvesting, and data exfiltration.
Web Security.reason_zh: SharePoint中的服务器端请求伪造漏洞允许攻击者在网络上提升权限，实现内网横向移动、元数据收集和数据外泄。

Web Security.reason: Cross-site scripting in SharePoint facilitates network-based spoofing and credential theft within enterprise collaboration portals, undermining user trust and session security.
Web Security.reason_en: Cross-site scripting in SharePoint facilitates network-based spoofing and credential theft within enterprise collaboration portals, undermining user trust and session security.
Web Security.reason_zh: SharePoint中的跨站脚本漏洞可在企业协作门户中促成基于网络的欺骗和凭证窃取，破坏用户信任和会话安全。

Web Security.reason: Heap-based buffer overflow in IIS permits local privilege escalation on web servers, critical for preventing lateral movement and maintaining hardened DMZ architectures.
Web Security.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in IIS permits local privilege escalation on web servers, critical for preventing lateral movement and maintaining hardened DMZ architectures.
Web Security.reason_zh: IIS中的堆缓冲区溢出漏洞允许在Web服务器上实现本地权限提升，对于防止横向移动和维护加固的DMZ架构至关重要。

Web Security.reason: Unsafe deserialization in Microsoft Office SharePoint enables remote code execution. This classic vulnerability chain frequently leads to full server compromise in enterprise collaboration platforms.
Web Security.reason_en: Unsafe deserialization in Microsoft Office SharePoint enables remote code execution. This classic vulnerability chain frequently leads to full server compromise in enterprise collaboration platforms.
Web Security.reason_zh: Microsoft Office SharePoint中的不安全反序列化可导致远程代码执行。此类经典漏洞链在企业协作平台中常导致服务器完全沦陷。

Web Security.reason: Server-side request forgery in SharePoint allows privilege escalation over the network. Attackers can pivot to internal services, bypassing perimeter defenses to extract sensitive corporate data.
Web Security.reason_en: Server-side request forgery in SharePoint allows privilege escalation over the network. Attackers can pivot to internal services, bypassing perimeter defenses to extract sensitive corporate data.
Web Security.reason_zh: SharePoint中的服务器端请求伪造漏洞允许通过网络提升权限。攻击者可跳转至内部服务，绕过边界防御以提取敏感的企业数据。

Web Security.reason: Cross-site scripting in SharePoint permits remote spoofing by unauthorized actors. This facilitates persistent phishing campaigns and session hijacking against enterprise users.
Web Security.reason_en: Cross-site scripting in SharePoint permits remote spoofing by unauthorized actors. This facilitates persistent phishing campaigns and session hijacking against enterprise users.
Web Security.reason_zh: SharePoint中的跨站脚本漏洞允许未授权方进行远程欺骗。这助长了针对企业用户的持续性钓鱼攻击和会话劫持。

Web Security.reason: CVSS 9 cross-site scripting in SharePoint allows attackers to execute malicious scripts in privileged contexts, facilitating account takeover and data exfiltration.
Web Security.reason_en: CVSS 9 cross-site scripting in SharePoint allows attackers to execute malicious scripts in privileged contexts, facilitating account takeover and data exfiltration.
Web Security.reason_zh: SharePoint中CVSS 9的跨站脚本漏洞允许攻击者在特权上下文中执行恶意脚本，促成账户接管和数据外泄。

Web Security.reason: CVSS 8.2 XSS in the Azure Portal enables session spoofing, potentially granting attackers control over cloud resource management interfaces.
Web Security.reason_en: CVSS 8.2 XSS in the Azure Portal enables session spoofing, potentially granting attackers control over cloud resource management interfaces.
Web Security.reason_zh: Azure Portal中CVSS 8.2的XSS漏洞可启用会话欺骗，可能赋予攻击者对云资源管理接口的控制权。

Web Security.reason: CVSS 7.4 authentication bypass via capture-replay in MSAL for Node.js compromises developer SDKs widely used across cloud-native applications.
Web Security.reason_en: CVSS 7.4 authentication bypass via capture-replay in MSAL for Node.js compromises developer SDKs widely used across cloud-native applications.
Web Security.reason_zh: MSAL for Node.js中CVSS 7.4的通过捕获重放实现的认证绕过漏洞，会危及广泛部署于云原生应用中的开发者SDK。

Web Security.reason: Deserialization of untrusted data in SharePoint enables remote code execution. Directly threatens enterprise collaboration platforms and web application backends.
Web Security.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in SharePoint enables remote code execution. Directly threatens enterprise collaboration platforms and web application backends.
Web Security.reason_zh: SharePoint中不受信任数据的反序列化可导致远程代码执行。直接威胁企业协作平台和Web应用程序后端。

Web Security.reason: Missing authorization in SharePoint allows privilege escalation over the network. Compromises access controls and exposes sensitive organizational data to unauthorized users.
Web Security.reason_en: Missing authorization in SharePoint allows privilege escalation over the network. Compromises access controls and exposes sensitive organizational data to unauthorized users.
Web Security.reason_zh: SharePoint中缺失授权允许通过网络提升权限。破坏访问控制机制，使敏感的组织数据暴露给未授权用户。

Web Security.reason: Cross-site scripting in SharePoint facilitates network-wide spoofing attacks. Undermines user trust and enables session hijacking in web portals.
Web Security.reason_en: Cross-site scripting in SharePoint facilitates network-wide spoofing attacks. Undermines user trust and enables session hijacking in web portals.
Web Security.reason_zh: SharePoint中的跨站脚本漏洞可促成网络层面的欺骗攻击。破坏用户信任并在Web门户中实现会话劫持。

Web Security.reason: HTTP request/response smuggling in ASP.NET Core allows attackers to bypass security features like WAFs and proxies. This critical 9.1 CVSS flaw disrupts traffic inspection and web application defenses.
Web Security.reason_en: HTTP request/response smuggling in ASP.NET Core allows attackers to bypass security features like WAFs and proxies. This critical 9.1 CVSS flaw disrupts traffic inspection and web application defenses.
Web Security.reason_zh: ASP.NET Core中的HTTP请求/响应走私漏洞允许攻击者绕过WAFs和代理等安全特性。这一CVSS 9.1的关键缺陷会干扰流量检测与Web应用程序防护。

Web Security.reason: SQL injection in SharePoint enables privilege escalation over network connections. Attackers can manipulate database queries to escalate privileges and compromise collaborative content management systems.
Web Security.reason_en: SQL injection in SharePoint enables privilege escalation over network connections. Attackers can manipulate database queries to escalate privileges and compromise collaborative content management systems.
Web Security.reason_zh: SharePoint中的SQL注入漏洞允许通过网络连接提升权限。攻击者可操纵数据库查询以提升权限并攻破协作式内容管理系统。

Web Security.reason: Improper authentication implementation in ASP.NET Core allows privilege escalation over network. Weak access controls in web frameworks directly expose backend services to unauthorized elevation.
Web Security.reason_en: Improper authentication implementation in ASP.NET Core allows privilege escalation over network. Weak access controls in web frameworks directly expose backend services to unauthorized elevation.
Web Security.reason_zh: ASP.NET Core中身份验证实现不当允许通过网络提升权限。Web框架中薄弱的访问控制直接使后端服务面临未授权提权风险。

Web Security.reason: Stack-based buffer overflow in Internet Information Services (IIS) allows remote code execution, making it a prime target for widespread web server exploitation.
Web Security.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in Internet Information Services (IIS) allows remote code execution, making it a prime target for widespread web server exploitation.
Web Security.reason_zh: Internet Information Services (IIS)中的栈缓冲区溢出漏洞可导致远程代码执行，使其成为大规模Web服务器利用的首要目标。

Web Security.reason: Path equivalence resolution flaw in WebDAV enables remote code execution, commonly leveraged in file-sharing protocols and web application attack chains.
Web Security.reason_en: Path equivalence resolution flaw in WebDAV enables remote code execution, commonly leveraged in file-sharing protocols and web application attack chains.
Web Security.reason_zh: WebDAV中的路径等价解析缺陷可导致远程代码执行，常被用于文件共享协议及Web应用程序攻击链中。

Web Security.reason: Cross-site scripting flaws in Microsoft Office SharePoint enable attackers to perform credential spoofing and session hijacking against authenticated enterprise users.
Web Security.reason_en: Cross-site scripting flaws in Microsoft Office SharePoint enable attackers to perform credential spoofing and session hijacking against authenticated enterprise users.
Web Security.reason_zh: Microsoft Office SharePoint中的跨站脚本漏洞使攻击者能够针对已认证的企业用户实施凭证欺骗与会话劫持。

Web Security.reason: Use after free in Microsoft XML allows unauthenticated remote code execution over a network, impacting web applications and backend services relying on MSXML parsing.
Web Security.reason_en: Use after free in Microsoft XML allows unauthenticated remote code execution over a network, impacting web applications and backend services relying on MSXML parsing.
Web Security.reason_zh: Microsoft XML中的释放后使用漏洞允许通过网络实现无需认证的远程代码执行，影响依赖MSXML解析的Web应用程序和后端服务。

Web Security.reason: Use after free in Internet Explorer enables local privilege escalation through malicious web content, remaining a significant risk for legacy enterprise browser environments.
Web Security.reason_en: Use after free in Internet Explorer enables local privilege escalation through malicious web content, remaining a significant risk for legacy enterprise browser environments.
Web Security.reason_zh: Internet Explorer中的释放后使用漏洞可通过恶意Web内容实现本地权限提升，仍是遗留企业浏览器环境的重大风险。

Web Security.reason: Unsafe deserialization in SharePoint web applications permits remote code execution (CVSS 8.8) by processing crafted XML/JSON payloads.
Web Security.reason_en: Unsafe deserialization in SharePoint web applications permits remote code execution (CVSS 8.8) by processing crafted XML/JSON payloads.
Web Security.reason_zh: SharePoint Web应用程序中的不安全反序列化漏洞可通过处理构造的XML/JSON载荷实现远程代码执行（CVSS 8.8）。

Web Security.reason: Deserialization of untrusted data in SharePoint web interfaces allows remote code execution (CVSS 8.8), targeting common enterprise collaboration portals.
Web Security.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in SharePoint web interfaces allows remote code execution (CVSS 8.8), targeting common enterprise collaboration portals.
Web Security.reason_zh: SharePoint Web界面中不受信任数据的反序列化可导致远程代码执行（CVSS 8.8），主要针对常见的企业协作门户。

Web Security.reason: Heap-based buffer overflow in Microsoft Standard XPS processing affects web document rendering pipelines, enabling local privilege escalation (CVSS 7.1).
Web Security.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Microsoft Standard XPS processing affects web document rendering pipelines, enabling local privilege escalation (CVSS 7.1).
Web Security.reason_zh: Microsoft Standard XPS处理中的堆缓冲区溢出漏洞会影响Web文档渲染流水线，导致本地权限提升（CVSS 7.1）。

Web Security.reason: CVSS 8.8 missing authorization in Microsoft Office SharePoint allows network privilege escalation, bypassing access controls to modify or extract sensitive web content.
Web Security.reason_en: CVSS 8.8 missing authorization in Microsoft Office SharePoint allows network privilege escalation, bypassing access controls to modify or extract sensitive web content.
Web Security.reason_zh: Microsoft Office SharePoint中CVSS 8.8的缺失授权漏洞允许网络权限提升，绕过访问控制以修改或提取敏感Web内容。

Web Security.reason: CVSS 9.0 cross-site scripting in SharePoint facilitates network spoofing attacks against authenticated users, compromising trust, session integrity, and data confidentiality.
Web Security.reason_en: CVSS 9.0 cross-site scripting in SharePoint facilitates network spoofing attacks against authenticated users, compromising trust, session integrity, and data confidentiality.
Web Security.reason_zh: SharePoint中CVSS 9.0的跨站脚本漏洞可促成针对已认证用户的网络欺骗攻击，破坏信任、会话完整性和数据机密性。

Web Security.reason: CVSS 7.5 inefficient algorithmic complexity in ASP.NET Core enables network denial of service, targeting web server resource allocation and application responsiveness.
Web Security.reason_en: CVSS 7.5 inefficient algorithmic complexity in ASP.NET Core enables network denial of service, targeting web server resource allocation and application responsiveness.
Web Security.reason_zh: ASP.NET Core中CVSS 7.5的低效算法复杂度漏洞可导致网络拒绝服务，针对Web服务器资源分配与应用响应能力。

Web Security.reason: Heap-based buffer overflow in Microsoft Edge (Chromium) enables network RCE, leveraging the browser's massive user base for high-value phishing and drive-by exploitation.
Web Security.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Microsoft Edge (Chromium) enables network RCE, leveraging the browser's massive user base for high-value phishing and drive-by exploitation.
Web Security.reason_zh: Microsoft Edge (Chromium) 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出可导致网络远程代码执行，攻击者可利用其庞大的用户基数实施高价值钓鱼与漏洞利用。

Web Security.reason: Double free vulnerability in Microsoft Edge allows network RCE, providing attackers with reliable code execution vectors via malicious web content or extensions.
Web Security.reason_en: Double free vulnerability in Microsoft Edge allows network RCE, providing attackers with reliable code execution vectors via malicious web content or extensions.
Web Security.reason_zh: Microsoft Edge 中的双重释放漏洞可导致网络远程代码执行，使攻击者能够通过恶意网页内容或扩展程序获得可靠的代码执行途径。

Web Security.reason: Type confusion in the Chromium-based Edge rendering engine allows remote code execution via malicious web content, exploiting memory safety violations.
Web Security.reason_en: Type confusion in the Chromium-based Edge rendering engine allows remote code execution via malicious web content, exploiting memory safety violations.
Web Security.reason_zh: 基于 Chromium 的 Edge 渲染引擎中存在类型混淆漏洞，可利用内存安全缺陷通过恶意网页内容实现远程代码执行。

Web Security.reason: Server-side request forgery in Edge enables attackers to bypass authentication controls and access internal network resources through the browser.
Web Security.reason_en: Server-side request forgery in Edge enables attackers to bypass authentication controls and access internal network resources through the browser.
Web Security.reason_zh: Edge 中的服务器端请求伪造漏洞可使攻击者绕过身份验证机制，并通过浏览器访问内部网络资源。

Web Security.reason: Improper input validation in the browser engine leads to remote code execution when processing compromised or malicious web pages.
Web Security.reason_en: Improper input validation in the browser engine leads to remote code execution when processing compromised or malicious web pages.
Web Security.reason_zh: 浏览器引擎中存在的输入验证缺陷在处理受损或恶意网页时可能导致远程代码执行。

Web Security.reason: Cross-site scripting in Microsoft Exchange Server enables network-based spoofing attacks through the webmail interface.
Web Security.reason_en: Cross-site scripting in Microsoft Exchange Server enables network-based spoofing attacks through the webmail interface.
Web Security.reason_zh: Microsoft Exchange Server 中的跨站脚本漏洞可通过 Webmail 界面发起基于网络的欺骗攻击。

Web Security.reason: Path traversal in Exchange Server allows network-based code execution via maliciously crafted file paths in web endpoints.
Web Security.reason_en: Path traversal in Exchange Server allows network-based code execution via maliciously crafted file paths in web endpoints.
Web Security.reason_zh: Exchange Server 中的路径遍历漏洞允许攻击者通过 Web 端点中恶意构造的文件路径实现基于网络的代码执行。

Web Security.reason: SSRF in Azure Data Factory allows information disclosure by forcing the service to access restricted internal resources.
Web Security.reason_en: SSRF in Azure Data Factory allows information disclosure by forcing the service to access restricted internal resources.
Web Security.reason_zh: Azure Data Factory 中的服务器端请求伪造漏洞可通过强制服务访问受限的内部资源导致信息泄露。

Web Security.reason: SSRF in Microsoft Copilot for Azure exposes network information leakage risks within AI-integrated web services.
Web Security.reason_en: SSRF in Microsoft Copilot for Azure exposes network information leakage risks within AI-integrated web services.
Web Security.reason_zh: Microsoft Copilot for Azure 中的服务器端请求伪造漏洞在集成人工智能的 Web 服务中暴露出网络信息泄露风险。

Web Security.reason: Weak authentication in SharePoint allows unauthenticated security feature bypass; actively exploited in the wild as confirmed by CISA KEV listing.
Web Security.reason_en: Weak authentication in SharePoint allows unauthenticated security feature bypass; actively exploited in the wild as confirmed by CISA KEV listing.
Web Security.reason_zh: SharePoint 中的身份验证强度不足可导致未授权绕过安全功能；该漏洞已在实际环境中被积极利用，且已被 CISA KEV 收录确认。

Web Security.reason: Cross-site scripting in SharePoint enables unauthenticated remote spoofing, affecting widespread enterprise web portals and intranet applications.
Web Security.reason_en: Cross-site scripting in SharePoint enables unauthenticated remote spoofing, affecting widespread enterprise web portals and intranet applications.
Web Security.reason_zh: SharePoint 中的跨站脚本漏洞可导致未授权的远程欺骗攻击，广泛影响企业 Web 门户及内部网应用。

Web Security.reason: Server-side request forgery in SharePoint allows authenticated remote privilege escalation, facilitating internal network pivoting and lateral movement.
Web Security.reason_en: Server-side request forgery in SharePoint allows authenticated remote privilege escalation, facilitating internal network pivoting and lateral movement.
Web Security.reason_zh: SharePoint 中的服务器端请求伪造漏洞允许已认证用户实现远程权限提升，从而协助内部网络跳板攻击与横向移动。

Web Security.reason: Relative path traversal in PowerShell Core permits unauthenticated remote code execution, compromising automation scripts and deployment pipelines.
Web Security.reason_en: Relative path traversal in PowerShell Core permits unauthenticated remote code execution, compromising automation scripts and deployment pipelines.
Web Security.reason_zh: PowerShell Core 中的相对路径遍历漏洞可导致未授权的远程代码执行，危及自动化脚本与部署流水线。

Web Security.reason: Injection flaw in GitHub Copilot and Visual Studio allows unauthenticated remote security bypass, threatening developer toolchains and IDE integrity.
Web Security.reason_en: Injection flaw in GitHub Copilot and Visual Studio allows unauthenticated remote security bypass, threatening developer toolchains and IDE integrity.
Web Security.reason_zh: GitHub Copilot 与 Visual Studio 中存在的注入缺陷可导致未授权的远程安全绕过，威胁开发者工具链及集成开发环境的完整性。

Web Security.reason: Deserialization of untrusted data in Microsoft Office SharePoint enables remote code execution by authorized web application users.
Web Security.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in Microsoft Office SharePoint enables remote code execution by authorized web application users.
Web Security.reason_zh: Microsoft Office SharePoint 中对不可信数据的反序列化漏洞可使已授权的 Web 应用用户实现远程代码执行。

Web Security.reason: Insecure deserialization flaw in SharePoint allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code over the network.
Web Security.reason_en: Insecure deserialization flaw in SharePoint allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code over the network.
Web Security.reason_zh: SharePoint 中存在的非安全反序列化漏洞允许远程攻击者通过网络执行任意代码。

Web Security.reason: Missing authentication for critical SharePoint functions allows authorized attackers to escalate privileges and compromise web content.
Web Security.reason_en: Missing authentication for critical SharePoint functions allows authorized attackers to escalate privileges and compromise web content.
Web Security.reason_zh: SharePoint 关键功能缺乏身份验证机制，可导致已认证攻击者提权并篡改 Web 内容。

Web Security.reason: Out-of-bounds read in Microsoft Office allows local code execution through specially crafted document attachments.
Web Security.reason_en: Out-of-bounds read in Microsoft Office allows local code execution through specially crafted document attachments.
Web Security.reason_zh: Microsoft Office 中的越界读取漏洞可通过特制文档附件实现本地代码执行。

Web Security.reason: Heap-based buffer overflow in Office applications enables local code execution when users open malicious files.
Web Security.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Office applications enables local code execution when users open malicious files.
Web Security.reason_zh: Office 应用程序中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞可在用户打开恶意文件时触发本地代码执行。

Web Security.reason: Cross-site scripting vulnerability in SharePoint allows attackers to perform credential spoofing and session hijacking in web portals.
Web Security.reason_en: Cross-site scripting vulnerability in SharePoint allows attackers to perform credential spoofing and session hijacking in web portals.
Web Security.reason_zh: SharePoint 中的跨站脚本漏洞可使攻击者在 Web 门户中实施凭据欺骗与会话劫持。

Web Security.reason: SharePoint deserialization of untrusted data enables network RCE, critically impacting enterprise web collaboration and document management platforms.
Web Security.reason_en: SharePoint deserialization of untrusted data enables network RCE, critically impacting enterprise web collaboration and document management platforms.
Web Security.reason_zh: SharePoint 中对不可信数据的反序列化漏洞可导致网络远程代码执行，严重冲击企业 Web 协作与文档管理平台。

Web Security.reason: Microsoft Exchange Server authentication bypass allows network privilege escalation, undermining email server security and access controls.
Web Security.reason_en: Microsoft Exchange Server authentication bypass allows network privilege escalation, undermining email server security and access controls.
Web Security.reason_zh: Microsoft Exchange Server 的身份验证绕过漏洞可实现网络权限提升，削弱邮件服务器的安全性与访问控制机制。

Web Security.reason: Active Directory Federation Services infinite loop causes network DoS, disrupting federated identity and single sign-on services.
Web Security.reason_en: Active Directory Federation Services infinite loop causes network DoS, disrupting federated identity and single sign-on services.
Web Security.reason_zh: Active Directory Federation Services 中的无限循环漏洞可导致网络拒绝服务，中断联合身份认证与单点登录服务。

Web Security.reason: Heap-based buffer overflow in Microsoft JScript enables remote code execution over the network, posing significant risks for applications and legacy systems relying on browser scripting engines.
Web Security.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Microsoft JScript enables remote code execution over the network, posing significant risks for applications and legacy systems relying on browser scripting engines.
Web Security.reason_zh: Microsoft JScript 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞可导致网络远程代码执行，对依赖浏览器脚本引擎的应用程序及遗留系统构成重大安全风险。

Web Security.reason: Cross-site scripting in Azure Storage Explorer facilitates session hijacking and privilege escalation in web-hybrid storage interfaces.
Web Security.reason_en: Cross-site scripting in Azure Storage Explorer facilitates session hijacking and privilege escalation in web-hybrid storage interfaces.
Web Security.reason_zh: Azure Storage Explorer 中的跨站脚本漏洞可助长 Web 混合存储接口中的会话劫持与权限提升。

Web Security.reason: Stored cross-site scripting in SharePoint enables phishing campaigns and credential theft targeting enterprise users.
Web Security.reason_en: Stored cross-site scripting in SharePoint enables phishing campaigns and credential theft targeting enterprise users.
Web Security.reason_zh: SharePoint 中存在的存储型跨站脚本漏洞可支持针对企业用户的钓鱼攻击与凭据窃取活动。

Web Security.reason: Race condition in Microsoft Edge could potentially be exploited for sandbox escape or local privilege escalation in the browser.
Web Security.reason_en: Race condition in Microsoft Edge could potentially be exploited for sandbox escape or local privilege escalation in the browser.
Web Security.reason_zh: Microsoft Edge 中存在的竞态条件漏洞可能被利用以实现沙箱逃逸或浏览器本地权限提升。

Web Security.reason: Denial-of-service vulnerability in Active Directory Federation Services threatens authentication availability for connected enterprise systems.
Web Security.reason_en: Denial-of-service vulnerability in Active Directory Federation Services threatens authentication availability for connected enterprise systems.
Web Security.reason_zh: Active Directory Federation Services 中的拒绝服务漏洞将影响关联企业系统的身份验证可用性。

Web Security.reason: Listed in CISA KEV, code injection in SharePoint enables remote code execution over networks, widely targeted by threat actors for initial access.
Web Security.reason_en: Listed in CISA KEV, code injection in SharePoint enables remote code execution over networks, widely targeted by threat actors for initial access.
Web Security.reason_zh: 该漏洞已被 CISA KEV 收录，SharePoint 中的代码注入漏洞可导致网络远程代码执行，常被威胁行为体用作获取初始访问权限的攻击入口。

Web Security.reason: Deserialization of untrusted data in SharePoint allows remote code execution, exploiting common enterprise collaboration platforms for full system compromise.
Web Security.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in SharePoint allows remote code execution, exploiting common enterprise collaboration platforms for full system compromise.
Web Security.reason_zh: SharePoint 中对不可信数据的反序列化漏洞可导致远程代码执行，攻击者可借此利用主流企业协作平台实现系统完全控制。

Web Security.reason: Another critical SharePoint deserialization flaw enables remote code execution, highlighting systemic risks in Microsoft web-based document management services.
Web Security.reason_en: Another critical SharePoint deserialization flaw enables remote code execution, highlighting systemic risks in Microsoft web-based document management services.
Web Security.reason_zh: SharePoint反序列化漏洞可导致远程代码执行，凸显了微软基于Web的文档管理服务中的系统性风险。

Web Security.reason: Deserialization vulnerability in Microsoft Office SharePoint permits remote code execution, affecting enterprise content management and sharing workflows.
Web Security.reason_en: Deserialization vulnerability in Microsoft Office SharePoint permits remote code execution, affecting enterprise content management and sharing workflows.
Web Security.reason_zh: Microsoft Office SharePoint中的反序列化漏洞允许远程代码执行，影响企业内容管理与共享工作流。

Web Security.reason: SSRF in Skype for Business allows network information disclosure, potentially bypassing internal network security controls and revealing backend architecture.
Web Security.reason_en: SSRF in Skype for Business allows network information disclosure, potentially bypassing internal network security controls and revealing backend architecture.
Web Security.reason_zh: Skype for Business中的SSRF漏洞可导致网络信息泄露，可能绕过内部网络安全控制并暴露后端架构。

Web Security.reason: Deserialization flaw in SharePoint enables remote code execution over the network, directly compromising enterprise web collaboration platforms.
Web Security.reason_en: Deserialization flaw in SharePoint enables remote code execution over the network, directly compromising enterprise web collaboration platforms.
Web Security.reason_zh: SharePoint中的反序列化漏洞支持通过网络进行远程代码执行，直接危及企业Web协作平台。

Web Security.reason: Exchange Server heap overflow allows remote code execution, targeting a critical email infrastructure component with high organizational impact.
Web Security.reason_en: Exchange Server heap overflow allows remote code execution, targeting a critical email infrastructure component with high organizational impact.
Web Security.reason_zh: Exchange Server堆溢出漏洞可导致远程代码执行，针对关键邮件基础设施组件，对企业组织具有重大影响。

Web Security.reason: Cross-site scripting in Exchange facilitates account spoofing and phishing attacks within webmail interfaces, degrading user trust and security.
Web Security.reason_en: Cross-site scripting in Exchange facilitates account spoofing and phishing attacks within webmail interfaces, degrading user trust and security.
Web Security.reason_zh: Exchange中的跨站脚本（XSS）漏洞可在Webmail界面中助长账户伪造和钓鱼攻击，降低用户信任度与安全性。

Web Security.reason: Uncaught exceptions in .NET can lead to local privilege escalation, potentially destabilizing ASP.NET applications and server-side web logic.
Web Security.reason_en: Uncaught exceptions in .NET can lead to local privilege escalation, potentially destabilizing ASP.NET applications and server-side web logic.
Web Security.reason_zh: .NET中未捕获的异常可能导致本地权限提升，进而破坏ASP.NET应用程序及服务器端Web逻辑的稳定性。

Web Security.reason: Integer overflow in .NET Framework may trigger local code execution, posing risks to backend web services relying on managed runtime environments.
Web Security.reason_en: Integer overflow in .NET Framework may trigger local code execution, posing risks to backend web services relying on managed runtime environments.
Web Security.reason_zh: .NET Framework中的整数溢出可能触发本地代码执行，对依赖托管运行环境的后端Web服务构成风险。

Web Security.reason: Actively exploited deserialization flaw in SharePoint enables remote code execution in enterprise web portals, as confirmed by CISA KEV listing.
Web Security.reason_en: Actively exploited deserialization flaw in SharePoint enables remote code execution in enterprise web portals, as confirmed by CISA KEV listing.
Web Security.reason_zh: SharePoint中存在被主动利用的反序列化漏洞，可在企业Web门户中实现远程代码执行，CISA KEV目录已确认此情况。

Web Security.reason: Critical deserialization vulnerability in Microsoft Office SharePoint is currently leveraged in the wild for widespread network attacks.
Web Security.reason_en: Critical deserialization vulnerability in Microsoft Office SharePoint is currently leveraged in the wild for widespread network attacks.
Web Security.reason_zh: Microsoft Office SharePoint中的严重反序列化漏洞目前已在实际环境中被利用，用于发起大规模网络攻击。

Web Security.reason: Cross-site scripting in Power BI facilitates phishing and credential theft within business intelligence dashboards accessed by corporate users.
Web Security.reason_en: Cross-site scripting in Power BI facilitates phishing and credential theft within business intelligence dashboards accessed by corporate users.
Web Security.reason_zh: Power BI中的跨站脚本（XSS）漏洞可在企业用户访问的商业智能仪表板中助长钓鱼和凭据窃取攻击。

Web Security.reason: Resource exhaustion in ASP.NET Core enables denial-of-service attacks against modern web application frameworks and hosting environments.
Web Security.reason_en: Resource exhaustion in ASP.NET Core enables denial-of-service attacks against modern web application frameworks and hosting environments.
Web Security.reason_zh: ASP.NET Core中的资源耗尽漏洞可对现代Web应用框架及托管环境实施拒绝服务（DoS）攻击。

Web Security.reason: Cross-site scripting in Microsoft Exchange Server facilitates account spoofing and credential theft across enterprise email platforms.
Web Security.reason_en: Cross-site scripting in Microsoft Exchange Server facilitates account spoofing and credential theft across enterprise email platforms.
Web Security.reason_zh: Microsoft Exchange Server中的跨站脚本（XSS）漏洞可助长企业电子邮件平台上的账户仿冒与凭据窃取。

Web Security.reason: Open redirect vulnerability in M365 Copilot enables privilege escalation and sophisticated phishing attacks against cloud productivity users.
Web Security.reason_en: Open redirect vulnerability in M365 Copilot enables privilege escalation and sophisticated phishing attacks against cloud productivity users.
Web Security.reason_zh: M365 Copilot中的开放重定向漏洞可导致权限提升，并对云生产力用户发起高级钓鱼攻击。

Web Security.reason: Open redirect in M365 Copilot Business Chat allows attackers to manipulate URLs for phishing and privilege escalation, exploiting trusted corporate domains.
Web Security.reason_en: Open redirect in M365 Copilot Business Chat allows attackers to manipulate URLs for phishing and privilege escalation, exploiting trusted corporate domains.
Web Security.reason_zh: M365 Copilot Business Chat中的开放重定向漏洞允许攻击者操纵URL以实施钓鱼和权限提升，利用受信任的企业域名。

Web Security.reason: XSS in Microsoft Live Share Canvas SDK enables network-based privilege escalation, threatening collaborative development environments and shared project data.
Web Security.reason_en: XSS in Microsoft Live Share Canvas SDK enables network-based privilege escalation, threatening collaborative development environments and shared project data.
Web Security.reason_zh: Microsoft Live Share Canvas SDK中的XSS漏洞可实现基于网络的权限提升，威胁协同开发环境与共享项目数据。

Web Security.reason: Severe path traversal in Etherpad's asset handler bypasses security checks, enabling remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on POSIX systems.
Web Security.reason_en: Severe path traversal in Etherpad's asset handler bypasses security checks, enabling remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on POSIX systems.
Web Security.reason_zh: Etherpad资产处理程序中的严重路径遍历漏洞绕过了安全检查，使远程攻击者能够在POSIX系统上执行任意代码。

Web Security.reason: Inadequate SQL filter sanitization in Dolibarr allows attackers to bypass denylists and trigger account takeovers via crafted search queries.
Web Security.reason_en: Inadequate SQL filter sanitization in Dolibarr allows attackers to bypass denylists and trigger account takeovers via crafted search queries.
Web Security.reason_zh: Dolibarr中SQL过滤清理不足，攻击者可绕过黑名单并通过构造的搜索查询触发账户接管。

Web Security.reason: Critical SSRF and URL validation bypass in Flyto2 Core allows attackers to redirect outbound requests and potentially access internal resources.
Web Security.reason_en: Critical SSRF and URL validation bypass in Flyto2 Core allows attackers to redirect outbound requests and potentially access internal resources.
Web Security.reason_zh: Flyto2 Core中存在严重的SSRF及URL验证绕过漏洞，允许攻击者重定向出站请求并可能访问内部资源。

Web Security.reason: The JTL-Shop web installer remains accessible and unchecked after deployment, allowing unauthenticated attackers to hijack the entire application setup.
Web Security.reason_en: The JTL-Shop web installer remains accessible and unchecked after deployment, allowing unauthenticated attackers to hijack the entire application setup.
Web Security.reason_zh: JTL-Shop Web安装程序在部署后仍保持可访问且未经检查状态，允许未认证攻击者劫持整个应用程序配置。

Web Security.reason: Attacker-controlled sort parameters in Daptin's GraphQL API bypass schema validation, directly leading to SQL injection and data exfiltration.
Web Security.reason_en: Attacker-controlled sort parameters in Daptin's GraphQL API bypass schema validation, directly leading to SQL injection and data exfiltration.
Web Security.reason_zh: Daptin的GraphQL API中由攻击者控制的排序参数可绕过模式验证，直接导致SQL注入和数据外泄。

Web Security.reason: A flawed URL scheme comparison in @fastify/reply-from enables path traversal and SSRF attacks by exploiting identical special schemes in base URLs.
Web Security.reason_en: A flawed URL scheme comparison in @fastify/reply-from enables path traversal and SSRF attacks by exploiting identical special schemes in base URLs.
Web Security.reason_zh: @fastify/reply-from中缺陷的URL协议比较可通过利用基础URL中相同的特殊协议，导致路径遍历和SSRF攻击。

Web Security.reason: Unvalidated calculation formulas in the Visforms Joomla extension are executed via PHP eval(), enabling backend users to run arbitrary code on vulnerable websites.
Web Security.reason_en: Unvalidated calculation formulas in the Visforms Joomla extension are executed via PHP eval(), enabling backend users to run arbitrary code on vulnerable websites.
Web Security.reason_zh: Visforms Joomla扩展中未经验证的计算公式通过PHP eval()执行，使后端用户能在易受攻击的网站中运行任意代码。

Web Security.reason: PHP-FPM request smuggling via unread HTTP bodies breaks backend connection reuse, facilitating cache poisoning and session hijacking attacks.
Web Security.reason_en: PHP-FPM request smuggling via unread HTTP bodies breaks backend connection reuse, facilitating cache poisoning and session hijacking attacks.
Web Security.reason_zh: 通过未读取HTTP请求体进行的PHP-FPM请求走私会破坏后端连接复用，助长缓存投毒与会话劫持攻击。

Web Security.reason: Unauthenticated SQL injection in Visforms frontend filters exposes sensitive database records directly from public web interfaces without requiring login.
Web Security.reason_en: Unauthenticated SQL injection in Visforms frontend filters exposes sensitive database records directly from public web interfaces without requiring login.
Web Security.reason_zh: Visforms前端过滤器中的未认证SQL注入漏洞无需登录即可直接从公共Web接口暴露敏感数据库记录。

Web Security.reason: Inadequate folder ownership validation in TeamPass allows authenticated users to hijack and re-parent other users' secure directories.
Web Security.reason_en: Inadequate folder ownership validation in TeamPass allows authenticated users to hijack and re-parent other users' secure directories.
Web Security.reason_zh: TeamPass中文件夹所有权验证不足，允许已认证用户劫持并重新归属其他用户的安全目录。

Web Security.reason: Use-after-free vulnerability in PHP error backtraces during request shutdown can be leveraged for remote code execution in web applications.
Web Security.reason_en: Use-after-free vulnerability in PHP error backtraces during request shutdown can be leveraged for remote code execution in web applications.
Web Security.reason_zh: PHP请求关闭期间错误回溯中的释放后使用（UAF）漏洞可被利用于Web应用程序的远程代码执行。

Web Security.reason: Stale memory reads in PHP magic method backtraces expose critical RCE vectors for modern web frameworks and CMS platforms.
Web Security.reason_en: Stale memory reads in PHP magic method backtraces expose critical RCE vectors for modern web frameworks and CMS platforms.
Web Security.reason_zh: PHP魔术方法回溯中的陈旧内存读取漏洞为现代Web框架和CMS平台暴露了关键的RCE攻击面。

Web Security.reason: Reflected XSS in the JTL Shop open orders panel exposes customer names to malicious scripts submitted via encoded registration fields.
Web Security.reason_en: Reflected XSS in the JTL Shop open orders panel exposes customer names to malicious scripts submitted via encoded registration fields.
Web Security.reason_zh: JTL Shop开放订单面板中的反射型XSS漏洞会通过编码注册字段提交的恶意脚本暴露客户姓名。

Web Security.reason: Actively exploited RCE in popular LLM proxy framework allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via malicious bytecode injection.
Web Security.reason_en: Actively exploited RCE in popular LLM proxy framework allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via malicious bytecode injection.
Web Security.reason_zh: 流行LLM代理框架中被主动利用的RCE漏洞允许远程攻击者通过恶意字节码注入执行任意代码。

Web Security.reason: Unauthenticated RCE in public-facing survey application logic allows attackers to manipulate HTTP requests and execute arbitrary code.
Web Security.reason_en: Unauthenticated RCE in public-facing survey application logic allows attackers to manipulate HTTP requests and execute arbitrary code.
Web Security.reason_zh: 面向公众的调查应用程序逻辑中存在未授权远程代码执行漏洞，攻击者可操纵HTTP请求并执行任意代码。

Web Security.reason: Deserialization of untrusted input during database restore enables PHP object injection, allowing arbitrary code execution in WordPress environments.
Web Security.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted input during database restore enables PHP object injection, allowing arbitrary code execution in WordPress environments.
Web Security.reason_zh: 数据库恢复期间对不可信输入进行反序列化可导致PHP对象注入，从而在WordPress环境中实现任意代码执行。

Web Security.reason: Cross-site scripting in the co-browsing feature allows unauthenticated visitors to execute JavaScript in agent browsers, compromising support sessions.
Web Security.reason_en: Cross-site scripting in the co-browsing feature allows unauthenticated visitors to execute JavaScript in agent browsers, compromising support sessions.
Web Security.reason_zh: 协同浏览功能中的跨站脚本漏洞允许未经身份验证的访客在坐席浏览器中执行JavaScript，从而破坏支持会话。

Web Security.reason: A PHP type-juggling authentication bypass in the WordPress migration plugin enables unauthenticated remote code execution through crafted batch file uploads, directly compromising web applications.
Web Security.reason_en: A PHP type-juggling authentication bypass in the WordPress migration plugin enables unauthenticated remote code execution through crafted batch file uploads, directly compromising web applications.
Web Security.reason_zh: WordPress迁移插件中的PHP类型转换认证绕过漏洞可通过构造的批处理文件上传实现未授权远程代码执行，直接危及Web应用程序。

Web Security.reason: Improper session cookie handling combined with shared caching headers enables cache poisoning attacks that can hijack user sessions on Grav-powered websites.
Web Security.reason_en: Improper session cookie handling combined with shared caching headers enables cache poisoning attacks that can hijack user sessions on Grav-powered websites.
Web Security.reason_zh: 不当的会话Cookie处理与共享缓存头结合可导致缓存投毒攻击，从而劫持基于Grav的网站上的用户会话。

Web Security.reason: Insufficient input sanitization in the WP-Slimbox2 plugin allows unauthenticated attackers to inject stored cross-site scripting payloads into rendered pages.
Web Security.reason_en: Insufficient input sanitization in the WP-Slimbox2 plugin allows unauthenticated attackers to inject stored cross-site scripting payloads into rendered pages.
Web Security.reason_zh: WP-Slimbox2插件中输入清理不足，允许未授权攻击者将存储型跨站脚本载荷注入渲染页面。

Web Security.reason: High-severity code injection in a widely used WordPress plugin allows attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable sites, posing significant risk to web infrastructure.
Web Security.reason_en: High-severity code injection in a widely used WordPress plugin allows attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable sites, posing significant risk to web infrastructure.
Web Security.reason_zh: 广泛使用的WordPress插件中存在高危代码注入漏洞，攻击者可利用其在易受攻击的站点上执行任意代码，对Web基础设施构成重大风险。

Web Security.reason: SSRF bypasses configured IP blocklists by only validating IPv4 addresses, enabling attackers to probe internal networks and exfiltrate sensitive data.
Web Security.reason_en: SSRF bypasses configured IP blocklists by only validating IPv4 addresses, enabling attackers to probe internal networks and exfiltrate sensitive data.
Web Security.reason_zh: SSRF漏洞仅验证IPv4地址即可绕过配置的IP黑名单，使攻击者能够探测内部网络并窃取敏感数据。

Web Security.reason: Race condition in single-use magic link validation allows token replay, effectively bypassing authentication controls and compromising user accounts.
Web Security.reason_en: Race condition in single-use magic link validation allows token replay, effectively bypassing authentication controls and compromising user accounts.
Web Security.reason_zh: 一次性魔法链接验证中的竞态条件允许令牌重放，有效绕过身份验证控制并导致用户账户被攻破。

Web Security.reason: Flawed TLS 1.3 handshake validation allows peer impersonation, undermining transport security and enabling man-in-the-middle attacks.
Web Security.reason_en: Flawed TLS 1.3 handshake validation allows peer impersonation, undermining transport security and enabling man-in-the-middle attacks.
Web Security.reason_zh: TLS 1.3握手验证缺陷允许对等方伪装，破坏传输安全性并启用中间人攻击。

Web Security.reason: Inadequate validation of OAuth callback parameters allows attackers to manipulate identity claims and impersonate legitimate users via third-party providers.
Web Security.reason_en: Inadequate validation of OAuth callback parameters allows attackers to manipulate identity claims and impersonate legitimate users via third-party providers.
Web Security.reason_zh: OAuth回调参数验证不足使攻击者能够操纵身份声明，并通过第三方提供商冒充合法用户。

Web Security.reason: CVSS 9.2 F5 NGINX HTTP/3 configuration flaw triggers a use-after-free condition in worker processes, potentially leading to remote code execution.
Web Security.reason_en: CVSS 9.2 F5 NGINX HTTP/3 configuration flaw triggers a use-after-free condition in worker processes, potentially leading to remote code execution.
Web Security.reason_zh: CVSS评分为9.2的F5 NGINX HTTP/3配置缺陷会触发工作进程中的释放后使用条件，可能导致远程代码执行。

Web Security.reason: CVSS 9.8 Apache Roller deserialization flaw allows unauthenticated remote attackers to execute arbitrary code by exploiting unsafe XML-RPC endpoint handling.
Web Security.reason_en: CVSS 9.8 Apache Roller deserialization flaw allows unauthenticated remote attackers to execute arbitrary code by exploiting unsafe XML-RPC endpoint handling.
Web Security.reason_zh: CVSS评分为9.8的Apache Roller反序列化缺陷允许未授权远程攻击者通过利用不安全的XML-RPC端点处理来执行任意代码。

Web Security.reason: CVSS 9.3 Idunno.AntiCsrf deserialization vulnerability enables remote code execution through object injection due to flawed double-submit cookie validation.
Web Security.reason_en: CVSS 9.3 Idunno.AntiCsrf deserialization vulnerability enables remote code execution through object injection due to flawed double-submit cookie validation.
Web Security.reason_zh: CVSS评分为9.3的Idunno.AntiCsrf反序列化漏洞因双重提交Cookie验证缺陷，可通过对象注入实现远程代码执行。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Input validation flaw in .NET Framework allows network-based tampering, compromising the integrity of enterprise middleware deployments and backend service reliability.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Input validation flaw in .NET Framework allows network-based tampering, compromising the integrity of enterprise middleware deployments and backend service reliability.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: .NET Framework中的输入验证缺陷允许基于网络的篡改，破坏企业中间件部署的完整性及后端服务的可靠性。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Type confusion in .NET and Visual Studio enables network-based privilege escalation, affecting cross-platform development environments and compiled application execution.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Type confusion in .NET and Visual Studio enables network-based privilege escalation, affecting cross-platform development environments and compiled application execution.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: .NET和Visual Studio中的类型混淆漏洞可实现基于网络的权限提升，影响跨平台开发环境及编译后应用程序的执行。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Heap-based buffer overflow in SQL Server allows remote code execution. Authenticated attackers can exploit this to fully compromise database servers and exfiltrate sensitive data.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in SQL Server allows remote code execution. Authenticated attackers can exploit this to fully compromise database servers and exfiltrate sensitive data.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: SQL Server中的堆缓冲区溢出漏洞可导致远程代码执行。已认证的攻击者可利用此漏洞完全接管数据库服务器并窃取敏感数据。

Databases & Middleware.reason: SQL injection in SQL Server enables privilege escalation over a network. Manipulated queries can bypass security controls and allow execution of administrative commands.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: SQL injection in SQL Server enables privilege escalation over a network. Manipulated queries can bypass security controls and allow execution of administrative commands.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: SQL Server中的SQL注入漏洞可实现网络层面的权限提升。经过篡改的查询可绕过安全控制并允许执行管理命令。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Command injection in SQL Server allows remote code execution. Improper input sanitization enables attackers to run arbitrary system commands directly on the host machine.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Command injection in SQL Server allows remote code execution. Improper input sanitization enables attackers to run arbitrary system commands directly on the host machine.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: SQL Server中的命令注入漏洞可导致远程代码执行。不当的输入清理使攻击者能够在主机上直接运行任意系统命令。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Heap-based buffer overflow in SQL Server permits remote code execution. Network-facing database instances are highly vulnerable to exploitation via crafted T-SQL requests.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in SQL Server permits remote code execution. Network-facing database instances are highly vulnerable to exploitation via crafted T-SQL requests.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: SQL Server中的堆缓冲区溢出漏洞允许远程代码执行。面向网络的数据库实例极易通过构造的T-SQL请求遭到利用。

Databases & Middleware.reason: SQL injection in Microsoft Configuration Manager allows privilege escalation over a network, compromising infrastructure management databases and administrative functions.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: SQL injection in Microsoft Configuration Manager allows privilege escalation over a network, compromising infrastructure management databases and administrative functions.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: Microsoft Configuration Manager中的SQL注入漏洞可实现网络层面的权限提升，破坏基础设施管理数据库及管理功能。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Stack-based buffer overflow in SQL Server enables remote code execution over a network, directly threatening database engine integrity and data confidentiality.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in SQL Server enables remote code execution over a network, directly threatening database engine integrity and data confidentiality.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: SQL Server中的栈缓冲区溢出漏洞可实现网络层面的远程代码执行，直接威胁数据库引擎完整性及数据机密性。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Integer overflow in the .NET Framework runtime facilitates network-based privilege escalation, affecting application security boundaries and runtime stability.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Integer overflow in the .NET Framework runtime facilitates network-based privilege escalation, affecting application security boundaries and runtime stability.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: .NET Framework运行时中的整数溢出漏洞助长了基于网络的权限提升，影响应用程序安全边界及运行时稳定性。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Improper input validation in Exchange Server enables remote code execution, posing a critical risk to email infrastructure.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Improper input validation in Exchange Server enables remote code execution, posing a critical risk to email infrastructure.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: Exchange Server中的不当输入验证可导致远程代码执行，对电子邮件基础设施构成严重风险。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Code injection in Exchange Server allows remote code execution, significantly expanding the attack surface for mail gateways.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Code injection in Exchange Server allows remote code execution, significantly expanding the attack surface for mail gateways.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: Exchange Server中的代码注入漏洞允许远程代码执行，显著扩大了邮件网关的攻击面。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Exposed dangerous methods in SQL Server permit remote privilege escalation, creating direct administrative database risks.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Exposed dangerous methods in SQL Server permit remote privilege escalation, creating direct administrative database risks.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: SQL Server中暴露的危险方法允许远程权限提升，直接带来数据库管理风险。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Deserialization of untrusted data in SQL Server allows remote code execution over the network, directly endangering database integrity, backend workloads, and sensitive corporate data.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in SQL Server allows remote code execution over the network, directly endangering database integrity, backend workloads, and sensitive corporate data.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: SQL Server中对不可信数据进行反序列化可在网络层面实现远程代码执行，直接危及数据库完整性、后端负载及企业敏感数据。
